quotes.title: LHS 3844
quotes.card: LHS 3844, also named Batsũ̀, is a red dwarf star located 48.5 light-years away from the Solar System in the constellation of Indus.
quotes.introduction: The star has about 15% the mass and 19% the radius of the Sun.
